strand: Value of a kW of peak: GB Capacity Market clearing prices, distribution reinforcement unit costs, peaking-plant costs and planning kW per heat pump (comparators for the ~GBP 8/kW/yr cost of co-ordinated hybrid dispatch)
method_note: Every source below was downloaded (PDF or gov.uk HTML) and read via text extraction on 2026-11-07. 'PDF p.' is the page index of the downloaded file. Quotes are verbatim from the extracted text; table rows are quoted as extracted, with ' ... ' marking omitted rows. Capacity Market clearing prices are GBP per kW of DE-RATED capacity per year, in the auction's price base and then CPI-indexed over the agreement; they are not directly per kW of nameplate. Figures marked 'derived' are this reviewer's arithmetic, not the source's claim.

claims.claim: The auction demand curve is anchored on a net Cost of New Entry of GBP 49/kW/year, with a GBP 75 cap: the administratively estimated annual cost of firm new capacity.

claims.claim: The SRVD funds reinforcement (or flexibility) only for highly utilised assets, i.e. transformers above or forecast above 100% utilisation.
claims.quote: The purpose of the SRVD is to fund reinforcement works (or flexibility services) for assets that are highly utilised. For transformers, the threshold for the SRVD is where utilisation is above, or forecast to be above, 100%.
claims.locator: para 3.2, PDF p. 21
